Peter,

Every four years, Americans gather around their TVs with pride in their hearts.

We cheer for the red, white, and blue.
We celebrate the athletes who carry our flag onto the world stage.
We believe they represent us.

But lately, something has changed.

Too many Olympians no longer see themselves as ambassadors of a united nation _**-- but as radical activists with a global microphone.**_

Olympians should use their platform to inspire the nation and show what is possible when you work hard to achieve your dreams. Instead, they're using their platform to make political statements.
**_" Just because I'm wearing the flag doesn't mean I represent everything that's going on in the US."_
- Hunter Hess, Freestyle Skier**
The Olympians on Team USA have benefited from the freedoms that make America great, but they are bad-mouthing the United States on the world stage.

To make matters worse, the U.S. Olympic Committee is allowing this to happen.

Even though they claim to be committed to athletic excellence and community growth, their athletes are alienating entire sections of our community with their intolerance for diverging points of view.

That's not unity. That's not sportsmanship. And it's certainly not tolerance.

New Tolerance Campaign is the nation's leading watchdog organization mobilizing Americans to confront intolerance and double standards by establishment institutions, universities, and socially-conscious brands.

I'm Chad Banghart, the President of the New Tolerance Campaign (NTC). I set a goal to raise $10,000 before the end of the month to challenge this gold-medal worthy hypocrisy.

At the New Tolerance Campaign, we believe that if you **represent** America, you should **respect** America.

Representing Team USA should look like:
* Pride in the flag.
* Respect for competitors.
* Understanding 340M+ Americans are supporting you.

But those aren't the athletes that you hear about in the media.

Instead, they are focusing on the athletes who choose to spread a message of division and radical intolerance.

**New Tolerance Campaign is the only organization taking a stand against hypocritical mainstream intolerance.**

Our action campaigns empower ordinary Americans to hold self-proclaimed arbiters of tolerance accountable when they betray their stated values.

We cheer for the red, white, and blue. We celebrate the athletes who carry our flag onto the world stage. We believe they represent us. But lately, something has changed. Too many Olympians no longer see themselves as ambassadors of a united nation -- but as radical activists with a global microphone. Olympians should use their platform to inspire the nation and show what is possible when you work hard to achieve your dreams. Instead, they're using their platform to make political statements. " Just because I'm wearing the flag doesn't mean I represent everything that's going on in the US." - Hunter Hess, Freestyle Skier The Olympians on Team USA have benefited from the freedoms that make America great, but they are bad-mouthing the United States on the world stage. To make matters worse, the U.S. Olympic Committee is allowing this to happen. Even though they claim to be committed to athletic excellence and community growth, their athletes are alienating entire sections of our community with their intolerance for diverging points of view. That's not unity. That's not sportsmanship. And it's certainly not tolerance. New Tolerance Campaign is the nation's leading watchdog organization mobilizing Americans to confront intolerance and double standards by establishment institutions, universities, and socially-conscious brands. At the New Tolerance Campaign, we believe that if you represent America, you should respect America. Representing Team USA should look like: Pride in the flag. Respect for competitors. Understanding 340M+ Americans are supporting you. But those aren't the athletes that you hear about in the media. Instead, they are focusing on the athletes who choose to spread a message of division and radical intolerance. New Tolerance Campaign is the only organization taking a stand against hypocritical mainstream intolerance. Our action campaigns empower ordinary Americans to hold self-proclaimed arbiters of tolerance accountable when they betray their stated values. With our growing community of more than 100,000 activists throughout all 50 states, we are able to drive action against hypocrisy in the media and bring about real change. Thank you, Chad A. When I left Nashville two years ago and moved to Florida I had no idea what would be in front of me. I just knew I needed a change and a new adventure.

Nashville had opened her arms to me in so many ways.

First when I moved there 25 years prior to try my hand at a singer/songwriting career.

Then starting a cleaning company ( Gigis Cleaning Co) to help fund my singing career. I had so many wonderful clients who opened their homes and let me clean for them.
Then I completely branched out and created something that not too many people had caught on to yet. It was a far fetched idea that was so risky. I opened my first cupcake shop on music row. Did lots of people think I was crazy ? Yes! But Nashville being the way it is its always open to something new, different and creative jumped right in and supported one of their own!
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.6rXUEe1Fj_xLHf8Fzq_eJnmXI0uu82DoIsVeIHfUwgI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=188709261)
Nashville embraces Entrepreneurs of all kinds. The locals support local because they were once new and starting out so they want to "Pay it forward".
You never know what talented artist might emerge from the masses or what great Resturant might come out of no where offering some delicacy that is the best thing on earth!
Well, in 2021 it was clear to me that the door of opportunity had closed. At least in my mind. After having to shut the door to my latest creation Pies By Gigi in Brentwood just a few minutes south of Nashville and it taking all of my funds and resources I felt like a failure and just needed a break. Coming back often in the last 2 years though has made me realize how much I missed it.

Although it can be a tough town it also has a certain charm that is unique and all its own.

Flying in tonight high above the city seeing all the beautiful lights, downtown broadway bars and hundreds of church steeples I could feel the energy in the atmosphere beckoning me and welcoming me home. Reminding me that even if we have been broken or feel like we have failed...there is always hope, healing power and a new creation right around the corner.

It reminds me of the song "Bless the Broken Road" by Rascal Flatts. Every long lost dream leads me to where you are, others who broke my heart they were like northern stars, pointing me on my way...

God Blesses broken roads. He can heal a broken heart , renew a disappointed tired spirit, and heal all wounds.
He can make all of our brokenness and things we think are failures into something beautiful if we let him.
If you have a spirit filled with Hope who knows what's right around the bend waiting for you.

It's a Blue Ocean, just waiting for you to jump in.

***SAVORY STUFFED PIES by Gigi**

**INGREDIENTS**
1 cup chopped cooked chicken breast, 3/4 cup mashed potatoes (made from a box of instand potatoes), 4 ounces cream cheese - softened, 1/2 cup frozen mixed vegetables - cooked, 2 tablespoons fresh parsley - chopped, 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning, salt and black pepper, 1 1/2 (14 oz.) packages piecrust or homemade, 1 large egg - beaten, Poppy seeds (optional)

**DIRECTIONS**
* Preheat oven to 400 F. Lightly grease a baking sheet.
* In a large bowl, stir together the chicken, mashed potatoes, cream cheese, begetables, parsley, poultry seasoning, and salt and pepper to taste.
* Roll out the piecrust and using a medium-size bisuit cutter, make individual circles of dough.
* Place about 3 tablespoons of the chicken mixture just below the center of each dough circle.
* Fold the dough over the filling, using a fork to press and seal the edges.
* Arrange the pies on the prepared baknig sheet.
* Brush with the egg and, if desired, sprinkle with the poppy seeds.
* Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown.

Sometimes "coming home" looks like landing in Nashville with a suitcase, a pie box, and a brand-new attitude. | | | Feb 21 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- When I left Nashville two years ago and moved to Florida I had no idea what would be in front of me. I just knew I needed a change and a new adventure. Nashville had opened her arms to me in so many ways. First when I moved there 25 years prior to try my hand at a singer/songwriting career. Then starting a cleaning company ( Gigis Cleaning Co) to help fund my singing career. I had so many wonderful clients who opened their homes and let me clean for them. Then I completely branched out and created something that not too many people had caught on to yet. It was a far fetched idea that was so risky. I opened my first cupcake shop on music row. Did lots of people think I was crazy ? Yes! But Nashville being the way it is its always open to something new, different and creative jumped right in and supported one of their own! Nashville embraces Entrepreneurs of all kinds. The locals support local because they were once new and starting out so they want to "Pay it forward". You never know what talented artist might emerge from the masses or what great Resturant might come out of no where offering some delicacy that is the best thing on earth! Well, in 2021 it was clear to me that the door of opportunity had closed. At least in my mind. After having to shut the door to my latest creation Pies By Gigi in Brentwood just a few minutes south of Nashville and it taking all of my funds and resources I felt like a failure and just needed a break. Coming back often in the last 2 years though has made me realize how much I missed it. Although it can be a tough town it also has a certain charm that is unique and all its own. Flying in tonight high above the city seeing all the beautiful lights, downtown broadway bars and hundreds of church steeples I could feel the energy in the atmosphere beckoning me and welcoming me home. Reminding me that even if we have been broken or feel like we have failed...there is always hope, healing power and a new creation right around the corner. It reminds me of the song "Bless the Broken Road" by Rascal Flatts. Every long lost dream leads me to where you are, others who broke my heart they were like northern stars, pointing me on my way... God Blesses broken roads. He can heal a broken heart , renew a disappointed tired spirit, and heal all wounds. He can make all of our brokenness and things we think are failures into something beautiful if we let him. If you have a spirit filled with Hope who knows what's right around the bend waiting for you. It's a Blue Ocean, just waiting for you to jump in. *SAVORY STUFFED PIES by Gigi INGREDIENTS 1 cup chopped cooked chicken breast, 3/4 cup mashed potatoes (made from a box of instand potatoes), 4 ounces cream cheese - softened, 1/2 cup frozen mixed vegetables - cooked, 2 tablespoons fresh parsley - chopped, 1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning, salt and black pepper, 1 1/2 (14 oz.) packages piecrust or homemade, 1 large egg - beaten, Poppy seeds (optional) DIRECTIONS Preheat oven to 400 F. Lightly grease a baking sheet. In a large bowl, stir together the chicken, mashed potatoes, cream cheese, begetables, parsley, poultry seasoning, and salt and pepper to taste. Roll out the piecrust and using a medium-size bisuit cutter, make individual circles of dough. Place about 3 tablespoons of the chicken mixture just below the center of each dough circle. Fold the dough over the filling, using a fork to press and seal the edges. Arrange the pies on the prepared baknig sheet. Brush with the egg and, if desired, sprinkle with the poppy seeds. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown. *Recipe courtesy of 'The Secret Ingredient' Copyright (C) 2018 by Gigi Butler Editorial comments expressed in this column are the sold opinion of the writer. You may have heard of the horrific anti-voter bill – the SAVE Act – that is making its way through Congress, but have you heard of Ohio’s SB 293? This massive anti-democracy bill was signed into law recently and is already causing mayhem for voters across the state.

**It has been recently reported that 11,000 voters in my home county must update their voter registration information if they want to vote in the upcoming election or risk having their ballots thrown out.**

[**Ohio voters can check their registration status here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125843182/603089091/-436542035?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ODc2YzFmZS0zNTBmLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FqJg_80Twpe1vF2GnCd5KQaAZsi3Sc2RRTnhoFHXcI4=&emci=4207f07a-800e-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=6876c1fe-350f-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=23746811)

Under SB 293, the state must conduct monthly audits of the voter registration database and compare it against data from the Ohio Bureau of Motor Vehicles and the often-outdated SAVE Database, which is used to track citizenship status. If there are discrepancies, voter registrations are cancelled without any prior warning to voters. It also eliminates the 4-day grace period for mail-in ballots postmarked by Election Day to be returned.

**Republicans are being blatant with their plans:** They want to make it more difficult to vote in order to maintain control. Why? Because they know that they’re losing support due to their bad policies, **they would rather rig the game and take down our democracy than work _for_ the People.**

[**We must come together to protect voting rights and ensure the survival of our democracy. name: Katie Porter
subject: If lobbyists want to meet with me, they better bring their good ideas, not their checkbooks.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=40878%2E3422442%2EFbIN5D)
Peter,
A few years ago I attended a reception for newly elected Members in DC. A lobbyist came up to me and said “Well, I guess you’re one of the new Members we’ll never see.” I asked him why. He said it was because I didn’t take corporate PAC money.
Since that day, I’ve said clearly—**if lobbyists want to meet with me, they better bring their good ideas, not their checkbooks.**
Californians deserve to know that their Governor works for them.
Whether it’s been using my whiteboard to hold Wall Street CEOs accountable or passing legislation to prevent Big Pharma from raising prices, I’ve always been proud to fight for working people.
Our campaign is funded by real, working people, and our average online contribution this week is just $26. I rely on supporters like you chipping in to keep our campaign afloat.
**[Can you make a donation today to show we don’t need corporate PAC and lobbyist money to run a winning campaign?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260221_1_ak.6Jf_Bb&refcode=em20260221-40878&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=40878%2E3422442%2EFbIN5D)**

name: Redistricting Action
subject: re: The SAVE America Act
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
We need all hands on deck to defeat this anti-democracy bill in the Senate
|
---

Peter,
This past week, conservatives in the House passed their so-called ‘SAVE America’ Act — one of the biggest threats to voting rights in a generation. If enacted, this legislation would upend free and fair elections by imposing unnecessary burdens upon millions of voters.
Here’s a quick recap of what this bill would do:
* Require voters provide very specific proof of residency and citizenship — like a birth certificate or passport — to register to vote.
* Force Americans to show photo ID to vote while narrowing the list of acceptable IDs in most states, excluding student IDs.

If enacted, this legislation would upend free and fair elections by imposing unnecessary burdens upon millions of voters. Here’s a quick recap of what this bill would do: Require voters provide very specific proof of residency and citizenship — like a birth certificate or passport — to register to vote. Force Americans to show photo ID to vote while narrowing the list of acceptable IDs in most states, excluding student IDs. Mandate election officials purge voter rolls every 30 days, a move that could mistakenly remove eligible voters. End universal mail-in voting, forcing voters to apply to receive a vote-by-mail ballot. Let’s be clear: The SAVE Act solves a problem that doesn’t exist. Peter, Pam Bondi needs to resign as Attorney General.

The Attorney General is supposed to serve the Constitution – not Donald Trump.

The Attorney General is supposed to protect survivors – not doxx them.

The Attorney General is supposed to prosecute abusers – not protect them.

But during last week’s House Judiciary Committee, she made her position clear: she’s willing to protect Trump at any cost, and she’s willing to do anything to avoid accountability.

| | Unlike a lot of Senators, I wasn’t born with a silver spoon in my mouth. My mom worked as a receptionist and my dad worked as a newspaper distributor for the _Washington Post_ and as a car salesman. He used to tell my sister and me, “I jump on and off this dirty truck every morning so you won’t have to.” It was their work ethic that allowed me to become a first-generation college and law school graduate. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/40251?t=9&amount=25&akid=3463%2E52803%2Ex3srO4) **Our government fails working people because there aren’t many of us in Congress.** That’s by design, Peter. The billionaires that currently control Washington don’t want people like me in power, which is why they spent tens of millions of dollars trying to defeat me in 2024. They failed because of people like you, who gave what you could to help those who didn’t have a penny to spare. And this year, with the Senate majority on the line, we have to join together once again. **I’m doing everything I can to uplift the best Democratic candidates so we can take back the halls of power.**[**Will you chip in $10 to help me build a coast-to-coast blue wave ahead of this critical election?**](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/40251?t=10&amount=10&akid=3463%2E52803%2Ex3srO4) | | | [Donate](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/40251?t=11&amount=25&akid=3463%2E52803%2Ex3srO4)
---
40 years ago, my parents worked hard, spent frugally, and earned a better life for themselves and their kids. They saved up enough to buy a home and retire with dignity.
Today, an average salary barely covers the basics. **College savings, retirement savings, and emergency savings are out of the question for millions of Americans. Meanwhile, the wealthiest 0.01% are doing better than ever.**
So many of the issues I’m tackling on Capitol Hill never make mainstream headlines because they don’t affect corporations, billionaires, or politicians; they affect communities like the one that raised me up. Early detection and treatment of uterine fibroids. Tax credits for beauty industry businesses. Services for homeless youth. The unaffordable housing crisis.
I’m determined to build an economy that gives the working people of America their FAIR share of the prosperity they create. But if we’re going to create a government that works for us and not billionaires, we’ll need a grassroots machine to rival their millions.
[**Chipping in $10 or $25 today will get us off to a strong start. Every dollar helps my message of economic power reach more people and uplift a new generation of Democratic changemakers across America.**](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/40251?t=12&amount=25&akid=3463%2E52803%2Ex3srO4)

Angela

body:
The results of ICE’s occupation are devastating.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2099%2E791427%2EKozF8A)
**Friend, it’s time for accountability.**
ICE came into Minnesota at the direct request of the President. His goal was clear: seek revenge on the people of a state that didn’t vote for him, and make a show with violent force. The results are devastating.
Civil rights suspended in favor of gestapo tactics. Two Americans gunned down by federal agents. Hundreds beaten, tear-gassed, harassed, and shot at. Hundreds more arrested and shipped off to detention in tortuous conditions, many of them citizen and legal immigrants. Families ripped apart and forever traumatized. People scared to leave their homes and the local economy taking a massive hit.
[**It’s time for the perpetrators of this violence and chaos to face accountability, and that starts with DHS Secretary Kristi Noem. Please, sign on our petition today calling for Kristi Noem to be impeached by Congress:**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-impeach-kristi-noem/?source=em260221-1-180&akid=2099%2E791427%2EKozF8A)
**[SIGN ON NOW](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-impeach-kristi-noem/?source=em260221-1-180&akid=2099%2E791427%2EKozF8A)**
As DHS Secretary, Kristi Noem has overseen the transformation of ICE and Border Patrol from law enforcement officers to a personal, secret police force for this administration.
That secret police force has been rolled out with such carelessness and disregard for the American people that it looks like DHS and ICE sees the American people as the enemy.
When mistakes are made, or worse, people are killed, Noem doubles down on her defense of these brutal tactics. She has gone as far as labeling innocent people like Alex Pretti and Renee Good as “domestic terrorists”, and her spokespeople and direct subordinates constantly lie about incidents involving ICE, many of them directly disputed by video evidence.
And it goes beyond just Minnesota. We have seen the same scenes play out in Los Angeles, Chicago, Maine, and communities across the country. In each of these places, civil rights were thrown out the window under Noem’s watch, and people have been needlessly hurt or had their entire lives upended thanks to DHS’s incompetence and lack of interest in following the law.
At the same time, DHS has built a massive surveillance state to crack down on First Amendment dissent. They are using facial and voice recognition technology to make databases of Americans who protest and observe ICE activity, labeling them “domestic terrorists” as well — an ominous sign that Kristi Noem and her crew are preparing to justify any violent action against peaceful protesters in advance.
When the executive branch has failed their duty to the American people and the Constitution at such a massive level, the legislative branch has a clear remedy: Impeachment.
[**We are calling on Congress to join Ilhan Omar in seeking impeachment proceedings for Kristi Noem with the goal of removing her from office. By signing on today, you are helping us send a message that a groundswell of Americans are coming together to oppose this lawlessness and authoritarianism.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-impeach-kristi-noem/?source=em260221-1-180&akid=2099%2E791427%2EKozF8A)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-impeach-kristi-noem/?source=em260221-1-180&akid=2099%2E791427%2EKozF8A)**
It’s time for Kristi Noem to go. We hope you sign on.
In solidarity,
Team Ilhan

name: Roy Cooper
subject: What is flipping this seat worth to you?
body:
Emailing about making your first $5 donation to our campaign
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=616%2E124072%2EF8B6xp)
**[Peter, asking for your financial contribution isn’t my favorite part of campaigning, and I know you get a lot of these, but I need a few committed supporters to chip in. Your $5 donation could make the difference between victory and defeat in this toss-up race.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5828?amount=5&t=7&akid=616%2E124072%2EF8B6xp)** **Service is a privilege, Peter.** It’s why I have wholeheartedly dedicated my life to giving back to this nation that I love. It’s why I am running in one of the closest Senate races on the map — the toughest fight of my career. Because here’s something else that I believe: _Taking back this seat and returning power to the people is worth any fight._ And it’s one that I can’t win alone. Your contribution today could help us stay ahead of my far-right opponent in the polls — which have tightened in recent days. It could allow us to keep up with the GOP’s powerful PACs and mega-donors, all of whom are ready to pour money into NC to try to defeat me. It could determine whether we elect a leader who’ll be accountable to the people, or one who would continue to rubber-stamp anything President Trump desires. **[Peter, I have a question for you: Is $5 worth it to YOU to help flip this seat blue for the first time since 2008? If you’re with me, I’m counting on your contribution today.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5828?amount=5&t=8&akid=616%2E124072%2EF8B6xp)** | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5828?amount=5&t=9&akid=616%2E124072%2EF8B6xp)

Roy Cooper

body:
|
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=5228%2E35263%2E8MQvC6)
Peter, We always knew Jon Husted could be bought, but this is especially appalling. Take a look: [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2533?c0=stb-em-brown.jsGxFu&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260207_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=5228%2E35263%2E8MQvC6) Here are the facts: **New reports** **reveal that my opponent, Jon Husted, has taken 10x more money than any U.S. Senator from billionaire Leslie Wexner. Wexner is a longtime associate of Jeffrey Epstein and one of his co-conspirators.** It gets worse. Husted didn’t just take Wexner’s money. When the Senate had the chance to release the Epstein files and provide accountability for the victims, **Husted voted against it.
** Wexner’s most recent donation to Husted came _just a few weeks before that vote._ You do the math. It all makes me sick to my stomach. Ohioans deserve transparency. We deserve accountability.

**We deserve a senator who fights for working people, not one who protects the rich and powerful. Not one who protects the Epstein class. Not one who protects pedophiles.** I've spent my career holding powerful interests accountable – and I'm fighting as hard as I can to unseat Jon Husted and prove that working people, justice, and accountability matter more than protecting billionaires.

But no one person could win this fight alone. I need you, Peter.

[**If you believe the super wealthy shouldn’t get special treatment – and the truth shouldn’t be hidden –****I’m asking you to split $10 or whatever you can today to help us flip Ohio and bring accountability back to the Senate.**](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2533?c0=stb-em-brown.jsGxFu&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260207_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=5228%2E35263%2E8MQvC6)**
**
Thank you. In solidarity,

Taking back legislative power in Washington during these midterm elections is how we can quell the federal government’s dangerous actions. By electing Democrats and flipping the U.S. Senate, we can return accountability to our government. We can restore the checks and balances that are designed to protect the people from the powerful.

body:
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260221-215&t=1&akid=215%2E12592%2E1xpOa9)
Hey, I’m reaching out to you because what’s happening right now with redistricting demands our attention — and our action.
**We’ve seen this playbook before. In my home state of Texas, Trump and Greg Abbott rammed through a gerrymandered congressional map that attempts to steal five Democratic seats. And it didn’t stop there.**
Trump knows how deeply unpopular his agenda is. He knows that this means he’s going to lose his majority in the House of Representatives. And he knows that when he does, there will finally be a check on his lawlessness, accountability for his crimes and corruption, and real hope for a better future for this country.
But instead of changing course, he’s trying to cling to power by rigging the system itself. That’s what these attacks on free and fair elections are really about.
Across the country, Trump’s Republicans are trying to choose their voters instead of the other way around. We can’t stand by while that happens.
**That’s why Virginia matters so much right now.**
Virginians for Fair Elections is leading the fight to level the playing field by advancing a **temporary, emergency** redistricting amendment — one that puts voters first and gives the people of Virginia the final say.
This amendment would allow for updated congressional maps for the upcoming elections, and Virginians will be able to see the proposed maps for themselves before casting a vote.
This is what democracy _should_ look like.
**That’s why I’m asking you to stand with me and support Virginians for Fair Elections today. **[**A contribution of any amount right now will help fuel the organizing and outreach needed to pass this critical amendment and protect fair representation**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260221_1.XVBQxj&amount=3&refcode=20260221-215&t=2&akid=215%2E12592%2E1xpOa9)
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260221_1.XVBQxj&amount=3&refcode=20260221-215&t=21&akid=215%2E12592%2E1xpOa9)**
Thank you for stepping up.
— Beto
P.S. **[If you want to learn more about the amendment or the work Virginians for Fair Elections is doing, you can find more details on their website.](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/1080?t=22&akid=215%2E12592%2E1xpOa9)**

Virginia should never have elected a CIA spook as Governor. Before Abigail Spanberger (D, Langley) governor, before she was a phony moderate representing Virginia's 12th Congressional District in Washington, DC, she was a career CIA operative. Over nearly two decades of international deployments, she held several different passports and assumed several different identities. Extrapolated, this means Abby was also Betty and Judy and Mary and possibly Shaniqua and Charles. She was a tourist. A banker. Maybe a baker. A professor on European sabbatical. She was whatever she needed to be for the mission.
Every asset, i.e. human being, Spanberger the undercover agent was acquired through falsehoods. Every friendly "let's grab a drink" was premised on subterfuge. Every relationship based on deception. No one knew who the real Spanberger was as that is part of being a successful CIA agent.
Of course, this life of deception was (likely) for a good reason. The world is a dangerous place and don't doubt I would recoil knowing the many dark and dirty things my government has had to do to protect me, to keep bad guys at bay, to prevent the enemy for getting its hands on yellow cake uranium or bioweapons. I don't criticize Spanberger for her career and concede it is a necessary albeit unfortunate side of geopolitics.
But the better Spanberger was at espionage the more one should innately distrust her ability to be honest.
Much has been said about what war does to the warfighter. Think of the many movies depicting the soldier returned from battle with a severe darkness that has seeped into his soul. The military trains men to be killers, and their training, coupled with battle scars, does not vanish when they return home.
Hence the analogy: if the U.S. Government trained and rewarded Spanberger for mastering the art of deception, we should expect her to deceive.That is what she does now, except not to our enemies and for our good, but to us and for hers.
After the 2020 election, congressional democrats participated in an on-the-record interview with CNN's Jake Sherman and Manu Raju. When it was her chance to chime in, then Congressman Spanberger asked to be off-the-record so she could tear into her fellow democrats in a **[profanity-laced](https://substack.com/redirect/eeec467d-3cb7-43b0-9dd0-6c793590a342?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** tirade. Spanberger called their elections a failure blaming the "defund the police" rhetoric and increased use of Marxist language for preventing greater wins. "We lost members that shouldn't have lost" saying "we need to never use the word socialist or socialism ever again."
The interesting part of Spanberger's remarks is that she does not blast the democrats for **BEING** socialist or espousing socialism. She does not warn against the dangers of defunding the police as a policy position. No. _**She warns against saying it.**_
Said plainly: Spanberger yelled at her fellow democrats for being honest and warned/advised them to improve their rhetorical deception. She does not ask them to espouse the values of Americans who rejected their messages in the election. She does not ask them to reconsider their aggressive lurch to the left on critical national issues. From that honest speech, perhaps the first honest things Abby has every said, she is angry, not that they believe it, but that they say it.
That is why in her first month as Governor, Spanberger's remake of Virginia politics is not surprising albeit the policy prescriptions are shocking.
Once, she **[blasted](https://substack.com/redirect/ae014229-7dd1-4f87-97fa-06b9c9a7e247?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** gerrymandering, calling it "detrimental to our democracy", but now, comfortably enshrined with power, she **[signed](https://substack.com/redirect/e5cce7e2-fbdd-4856-833a-3b3df2b09dc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/e5cce7e2-fbdd-4856-833a-3b3df2b09dc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[a](https://substack.com/redirect/e5cce7e2-fbdd-4856-833a-3b3df2b09dc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/e5cce7e2-fbdd-4856-833a-3b3df2b09dc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[bill](https://substack.com/redirect/e5cce7e2-fbdd-4856-833a-3b3df2b09dc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to redistrict Virginia in a way which flips 4 districts to democrats. What changed? Nothing. Deception is a tactic.
On her campaign website Abby professes a desire to **[work with anyone](https://substack.com/redirect/429eb072-89ce-4b03-a284-3ae0cf7845dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who will abolish Virginia's universally hated "car tax", but now, comfortably enshrined with power, she let democrat legislators **[kill a bill](https://substack.com/redirect/9b3ccfcc-baf7-4a6a-b7c6-abec27dbd9d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** which would study ending it. What changed? Nothing. Deception is a tactic.
Spanberger's entire campaign was on "affordability" and yet the first six weeks of her Administration **[have seen proposals](https://substack.com/redirect/26d4cd1e-427d-4e59-9cb9-8e683c5b829b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for more than 50 tax increases, gun bans, green nonsense like gas powered leaf blower bans, abortion on demand, every transgender thing imaginable... and when pushed by Virginians (and the nation as it this insanity was making national news) Abby reverted to her training, and deceived. "We're focused on delivering real relief for Virginians" **[she posted](https://substack.com/redirect/bdf9660f-acee-4218-ac3c-9d4571e990db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on social media, saying more than half her affordability issues had passed the legislature. Nothing says affordable like more taxes.
"Remember Jerry: it's not a lie if you believe it," George Costanza famously told Jerry Seinfeld. George should have run for office. At least he was funny. Spanberger now resembles pure evil. Want proof? An illegal alien in Loudoun County, Virginia strangled his 8-year old sister with an extension cord to death. Spanberger **[refuses](https://substack.com/redirect/d1857273-3f16-44b9-88fb-f262261e41e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to turn him over to federal ICE agents.
To find the truth in a CIA spook, do not look for what they say in public but do in private. Spanberger's 2020 conference call was honest, and that is why the media so dutifully concealed it. On that call, she said "He [Trump] is not going to go away after this election". No, Abby, he was not. He did not. He's back, and bigger than ever.
Say what you want about Donald Trump, and there is certainly a lot to say, but there is no deception in his agenda. Not on tariffs, not on the border or immigration, not on "drill baby drill", or blowing up drug boats and cartel members into itty bitty pieces of shark food. Every single thing Trump is doing he said very clearly he was going to do. You can hate him for it and hold marches against it, but there is zero surprise factor. Zero.
Spanberger and most democrats, all democrats really, have to lie about their policy agenda. No American would have voted for Biden if they knew it meant 10% inflation and 20million South American criminals getting free phones, so Biden lied. No Virginian would have voted for Spanberger if they knew it meant freeing fratricidal illegals or mandatory **[J6 education](https://substack.com/redirect/a7be4ec6-bb0a-49db-ba67-caad2cddc6a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in schools. So, she lied. Naturally. Comfortably. Professionally.
Of course she did. It's what she did for a living, and we are all the worse for it. Just wait until someone makes her their 2028 running mate: the blonde alpha female... she'll say even more things which aren't so, just as the CIA has taught her.
**I conclude with this:** I am not suicidal, and I don't have a chronic illness. You think I'm joking, but I know who my governor is, and I know what the CIA does. I have no idea what (or who) Spanberger has done for the mission, but I do know that a human casualty preventing operational success is something CIA spooks like Spanberger do not lose sleep over.
And if Bristol Farm were suddenly to experience a gas explosion (which would be odd considering I have no gas hook-up), it would be very easy for the CIA freak governor to lie about it. Getting her to tell the truth is the hard part.
**Honor and courage.**

The CIA rewarded Spanberger for mastering the art of deception, we should expect her to deceive | | | Feb 21 | | | | | | | | | | | | The Capitalist is a reader-supported publication Reject Corporate Left Wing Journalism | | ---|---|--- Virginia should never have elected a CIA spook as Governor. Before Abigail Spanberger (D, Langley) governor, before she was a phony moderate representing Virginia's 12th Congressional District in Washington, DC, she was a career CIA operative. Over nearly two decades of international deployments, she held several different passports and assumed several different identities. Extrapolated, this means Abby was also Betty and Judy and Mary and possibly Shaniqua and Charles. She was a tourist. A banker. Maybe a baker. A professor on European sabbatical. She was whatever she needed to be for the mission. Every asset, i.e. human being, Spanberger the undercover agent was acquired through falsehoods. Every friendly "let's grab a drink" was premised on subterfuge. Every relationship based on deception. No one knew who the real Spanberger was as that is part of being a successful CIA agent. Of course, this life of deception was (likely) for a good reason. The world is a dangerous place and don't doubt I would recoil knowing the many dark and dirty things my government has had to do to protect me, to keep bad guys at bay, to prevent the enemy for getting its hands on yellow cake uranium or bioweapons. I don't criticize Spanberger for her career and concede it is a necessary albeit unfortunate side of geopolitics. But the better Spanberger was at espionage the more one should innately distrust her ability to be honest. Much has been said about what war does to the warfighter. Think of the many movies depicting the soldier returned from battle with a severe darkness that has seeped into his soul. The military trains men to be killers, and their training, coupled with battle scars, does not vanish when they return home. Hence the analogy: if the U.S. Government trained and rewarded Spanberger for mastering the art of deception, we should expect her to deceive.That is what she does now, except not to our enemies and for our good, but to us and for hers. After the 2020 election, congressional democrats participated in an on-the-record interview with CNN's Jake Sherman and Manu Raju. When it was her chance to chime in, then Congressman Spanberger asked to be off-the-record so she could tear into her fellow democrats in a tirade. Spanberger called their elections a failure blaming the "defund the police" rhetoric and increased use of Marxist language for preventing greater wins. "We lost members that shouldn't have lost" saying "we need to never use the word socialist or socialism ever again." The interesting part of Spanberger's remarks is that she does not blast the democrats for BEING socialist or espousing socialism. She does not warn against the dangers of defunding the police as a policy position. No. She warns against saying it. Said plainly: Spanberger yelled at her fellow democrats for being honest and warned/advised them to improve their rhetorical deception. She does not ask them to espouse the values of Americans who rejected their messages in the election. She does not ask them to reconsider their aggressive lurch to the left on critical national issues. From that honest speech, perhaps the first honest things Abby has every said, she is angry, not that they believe it, but that they say it. That is why in her first month as Governor, Spanberger's remake of Virginia politics is not surprising albeit the policy prescriptions are shocking. Once, she gerrymandering, calling it "detrimental to our democracy", but now, comfortably enshrined with power, she to redistrict Virginia in a way which flips 4 districts to democrats. What changed? Nothing. Deception is a tactic. On her campaign website Abby professes a desire to who will abolish Virginia's universally hated "car tax", but now, comfortably enshrined with power, she let democrat legislators which would study ending it. What changed? Nothing. Deception is a tactic. Spanberger's entire campaign was on "affordability" and yet the first six weeks of her Administration for more than 50 tax increases, gun bans, green nonsense like gas powered leaf blower bans, abortion on demand, every transgender thing imaginable... and when pushed by Virginians (and the nation as it this insanity was making national news) Abby reverted to her training, and deceived. "We're focused on delivering real relief for Virginians" on social media, saying more than half her affordability issues had passed the legislature. Nothing says affordable like more taxes. "Remember Jerry: it's not a lie if you believe it," George Costanza famously told Jerry Seinfeld. George should have run for office. At least he was funny. Spanberger now resembles pure evil. Want proof? An illegal alien in Loudoun County, Virginia strangled his 8-year old sister with an extension cord to death. Spanberger to turn him over to federal ICE agents. To find the truth in a CIA spook, do not look for what they say in public but do in private. Spanberger's 2020 conference call was honest, and that is why the media so dutifully concealed it. On that call, she said "He [Trump] is not going to go away after this election". No, Abby, he was not. He did not. He's back, and bigger than ever. Say what you want about Donald Trump, and there is certainly a lot to say, but there is no deception in his agenda. Not on tariffs, not on the border or immigration, not on "drill baby drill", or blowing up drug boats and cartel members into itty bitty pieces of shark food. Every single thing Trump is doing he said very clearly he was going to do. You can hate him for it and hold marches against it, but there is zero surprise factor. Zero. Spanberger and most democrats, all democrats really, have to lie about their policy agenda. No American would have voted for Biden if they knew it meant 10% inflation and 20million South American criminals getting free phones, so Biden lied. No Virginian would have voted for Spanberger if they knew it meant freeing fratricidal illegals or mandatory in schools. So, she lied. Naturally. Comfortably. Professionally. Of course she did. It's what she did for a living, and we are all the worse for it. Just wait until someone makes her their 2028 running mate: the blonde alpha female... she'll say even more things which aren't so, just as the CIA has taught her. I conclude with this: I am not suicidal, and I don't have a chronic illness. You think I'm joking, but I know who my governor is, and I know what the CIA does. I have no idea what (or who) Spanberger has done for the mission, but I do know that a human casualty preventing operational success is something CIA spooks like Spanberger do not lose sleep over. And if Bristol Farm were suddenly to experience a gas explosion (which would be odd considering I have no gas hook-up), it would be very easy for the CIA freak governor to lie about it. Getting her to tell the truth is the hard part. Honor and courage. body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125850166/603107413/1734399078?amount=15&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.02.21_Jon-Ossoff-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDg4OWEzYy0zZTBmLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nO9n1mAZCjmIsbMSHtAFaRV07xpSjHPyJP5DAYSZqps=) See, I get why some folks voted for Trump.

He promised to attack a broken system. And it’s a ripe target.

Even before Trump came on the scene, America had one of the most corrupt political systems in the Western world.

It’s been running on corporate money, secret money, billionaire money.

And it’s worse than ever now.

_Citizens United_ was the worst court decision in modern American history.

When Members of Congress aren’t begging for money from Washington lobbyists, they’re trying to dodge getting carpet-bombed by super PACs.

Senators get threatened with millions of dollars of attack ads over the votes they take.

And see, that is why things don’t work for ordinary people.

It’s because the people’s elected representatives don’t represent the people. They represent the big donors!

That corruption is why they defunded nursing homes to cut taxes for the rich.

Corruption is why you pay a fortune for prescriptions.

Corruption is why your insurance claim keeps getting denied.

Corruption is why hedge funds get to buy up all the houses in your neighborhood, and then your corporate landlord ignores your calls during a gas leak.

Corruption is why that ambulance costs $3,000 after you just had to get your choking toddler to the hospital.

Yes, the system really is rigged.

But Trump’s not unrigging it. He’s re-rigging it for himself!

He’s a crook and a con man, and he wants to be a king.

You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you defund their hospitals and nursing homes.

You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you defund school lunch programs to help feed little boys and little girls whose hard-working parents are struggling to fill the fridge.

You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you do these things so you can cut taxes for the richest people in the country while you and your family business rake in massive sums from around the world.

Donald Trump’s second term has already done unfathomable damage to our country and the lives of millions of people.

And the people are beginning to see it.

But only by regaining Congressional power can we stop him.

| Early voting has begun in Northwest Georgia. That means voters are already casting their ballots. And in a special election like this one, early votes often decide who even makes the runoff.
That's the simple reality.
This election isn't about who has the loudest rallies or the most cable-news appearances. It's about who shows up consistently, who reaches voters early, and who has the organization to compete every single day until the last ballot is cast.
That's how we win.
I'm running because I believe Northwest Georgia deserves steady, serious leadership.

# Hi Everyone!

---
| | **You’re Invited:**
******We would love to have as many people as possible, even if you just stop by for a little bit. We will have pizza and salad along with snacks and drinks.**
**Ways to support people in ICE Custody:**[**Donate**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=79f20ce6f2&e=738470dca6)**to Rocky Mountain Immigrant Advocacy Network** RMIAN provides free legal and social work support to people detained at the detention center in Aurora and to children and families at risk of detention and deportation in the community. Legal staff at RMIAN represent people who cannot afford an attorney, and also provide free consultations, orientations, and know your rights guidance to detained and non-detained community members we cannot represent. Attorneys are also challenging unlawful, prolonged, and indefinite detention of people detained by ICE through federal district court litigation and legislative advocacy. Social workers work alongside attorneys to advocate in all areas of our legal work, supporting clients' legal cases and addressing their and their family's mental, emotional, social, and other needs. We all work together to advocate for people's liberation from detention and the freedom to choose where people build a safe and thriving future.
**Support Casa de Paz** Our primary mission is to welcome all immigrants getting released from the Aurora detention center; we also provide moral support via our Cartas de Paz Program (by writing to our detained friends) and via our Visitation Program (by visiting detained friends). [**Wishlists and Donate**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=6e62214dd1&e=738470dca6)[**Accepted Donations**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=b3fd6fc758&e=738470dca6)[**Commissary and Phone Fund**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=0cbaf25fa0&e=738470dca6)

**Other Ways to Support** **Zuri’s Campaign:** Ways to get involved and support our campaign.
[Sign up](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=585a351cc9&e=738470dca6) as a delegate for Zuri and if you want to go above and beyond volunteer for Zuri at Caucus (at the same link).

**Phone Banking:****Monday Phone Banking** Dates: February 23rd, March 2nd, 9thTimes: 5:30pm-7pmLocation: Online[REGISTER HERE](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=4809fc1056&e=738470dca6)Once you are trained you can make calls at any time
**Friday Phone Banking** Dates: January 27th, March 6th, 13thTimes: 5:30pm-7pmLocation: Online[REGISTER HERE](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=70475eed85&e=738470dca6)Once you are trained you can make calls at any time
**Last Wednesday Caucus and Assembly Training:** Dates: February 25thTime: 6-7pm (the first 25 minutes are the vital part, the last half is open to questions)Location: Online[REGISTER HERE](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=ba5ec18afb&e=738470dca6)
[**Donate**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=fd968e3535&e=738470dca6) \- Donations help with buying at table at Caucus and Assembly
**Local and National Update:**
**I’m sorry that I’m not out in the community as much while I focus on gaining support at Caucus and Assembly. Here are some issues that have been coming up in the meantime:**
[ The SAVE Act](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=47c64a8cd1&e=738470dca6) \- The SAVE Act has passed the House. Contact Senators Hickenlooper and Bennet to ask that they vote no on the SAVE Act which would require a birth certificate or passport to vote. This would amount to a poll tax. About 55% of Citizens do not have a passport and would be required to purchase one. Married women with name changes would be especially affected by this.Call Senator Bennet: 202-224-5852Call Senator Hickenlooper: 202-224-5941
[Check out the Southeast Strong Neighborhood Plan](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=0614203c1f&e=738470dca6) \- Let City Council know your thoughts on the plan, the goal of the plan is to invest in the Southeast and make it a region that thrives while uplifting its’ current residents. Email AllCouncil@ColoradoSprings.gov to provide feedback before February 24th the next City Council meeting. City Council has taken the plan off of the agenda, please email to ask that it be put back on the agenda.
[Board of Trustees Meeting](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=c47b631a40&e=738470dca6) \- Staff at Pikes Peak Library District have been instructed not to have a Black History Month Display. This is in line with their policy to not host cultural displays or displays with cultural emphasis. This has been confirmed by a current and former library worker. We are not accurately reflecting our community when we don’t have displays from a variety of cultures and we are not accurately representing our history.
[Contact](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=e4120cd464&e=738470dca6)[ ](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=fc035ea0a4&e=738470dca6)the PPLD Board of Trustees.
[**Help Reunite Edwin with his Fiance and Kids**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=2d8a2a7f3e&e=738470dca6)[****](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=ec27e71143&e=738470dca6)Their whole family has been through so much. Please donate to help them visit Edwin. Edwin was the main breadwinner for their family and it’s hard to recover from his loss of income and costs incurred while he was in ICE custody. Anything helps.
**Congressional District 5 Forum:** Here’s a [link](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=ceb7196a1d&e=738470dca6) to watch the forumHere’s a [link](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=c848e6d70c&e=738470dca6) to watch me answer additional questions that we weren’t able to answer at the forum.
**John Mikos’s Video in Support of My Candidacy:** Thank you for reaching out to share your support:[](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=59d8f8f618&e=738470dca6)**Part of Zuri’s Speech in Honor of Alex Pretti :**
[****](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=88828eb4c9&e=738470dca6)
**Zuri met with CC students at a dinner hosted by****Colorado Springs Sunrise Movement:**
****
We need a progressive in this fight who wont back down.
I will be your fighter.
**With love,****Zuri Horowitz****Candidate for Congress, CO-5****www.ZuriforCD5.com**
**No Contract, No Coffee.** Support striking Starbucks workers! Don’t cross the line while workers are on strike.
---
| | **Listen to my**[**podcast**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=3617532eee&e=738470dca6)**episode with Loving the Springs!****We talk about the importance of putting people first when it comes to all areas of policy.**
---
| | **Updates:**[**Donate**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=cfd14e74f6&e=738470dca6)**-** We made our first [ad](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=17b23c4ad1&e=738470dca6) with an Emmy winning editor. Now we need enough money to hire staff, and expand our outreach via door knocking, texts, postcards, and mailers.
[**Volunteer**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=ba6220fca8&e=738470dca6)**-** Our outreach strategy will rely on volunteers & minimize paper waste. If you haven’t signed up already, please do!

Your _follows_ , _likes_ , and _shares_ help a lot to let people know about our campaign!

The Fourteenth Amendment should not be up for debate. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWagAKMZbD6yK5h_eZEQ_vI8jk4Zg2GcChAAbhqMuNCTB41ngVOHn_yCXa5mB4CNr_bn_toykN0JC7R0kKAnBs35JCxaIZvCA49aPtKgWcOWe2AINuW724N90QKhY4Vz9LT2DK6ixORIGFG1DFJ90oQFyzHOeoa4lI8nks37qO5RUHROW72AeTYINNSnBN20NAoHbmO94JDX0-2BqZs5LVhmm561USchWAhm3KYoyD0E7Yz_G9Q1NOp_cc0MajBFH15_e9Lqi9TWZSA0yzqBtu0nPF0-1B9YrVkwzAMK8zw1wjPyOtKrC9G8u8w6CXOtNKEH0nT6lLo0xi6MOX-QRspA/4oc/PF_MI_mcQx2QKtnQZbFOnQ/h0/h001.WDJVVWk5HVKSp5WbTtQvFGLp5z2BlS7yovrboier8AU)

Friend, Every day, this corrupt administration attacks our constitutional rights, including our rights to due process, equal protection under the law, and birthright citizenship. **That’s why I’ve introduced the**** _Defend the Fourteenth Amendment Resolution_****to reaffirm and recognize the Fourteenth Amendment as a cornerstone of our multiracial democracy and to ensure that our democracy works for all of us, not just the powerful few.** The Fourteenth Amendment should not be up for debate, but as we speak, Trump’s corrupt Supreme Court is considering the constitutionality of Trump’s illegal executive order to end birthright citizenship. At the same time, ICE is breaking down people’s doors without judicial warrants and deporting people without trial. [**We’re demanding Congress re-affirm the Fourteenth Amendment and defend our constitutional rights. Add your name as a grassroots co-signer of the**** _Defend the Fourteenth Amendment Resolution_****now to demand Congress act.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fYoCOM0GhPtGWT4ibJudex8AC5ImWslns3sZeXNr7LEvWyncTUIrtrzX0frmGGNow-beYfHL3_vAbWWB0-79i03kVch8tLVW9p5KKXbGVUXtuHKyJoCaJb70yo1jTpz8kWfagz58gYGSiDLea9LJ4WTSQxTSLPd0q5WG1ucYAywIS5dKhKworb48McySJNgdakVls_J85I-HMg3KKW5mpWKh7An_PxZpxvb8gGYcsufwkojHJ2UVWkATWUCSkPtaNottUj0hfPFqm-eVqBpjDcernmJCNOScki4B6h7oW3Y-ZB5VHZCwEQ8W4pd4lCW3PpVyrPfTJ-KP7UD8bqC--yRvioEiltYynusbU36tD0goEPIhdZGbZPK-DENKC7-HXhb3G3Hmq8aRNQ_NYqjJPli_gIl2-uEiLa2nQHihe_cH-EeY4PeX1eKnW4jrp1f4/4oc/PF_MI_mcQx2QKtnQZbFOnQ/h1/h001._g_1fm1eMQlXoTeEW9cWo4I5QSJZChw9hAx-PWeq-EY) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fYoCOM0GhPtGWT4ibJudex8AC5ImWslns3sZeXNr7LEvWyncTUIrtrzX0frmGGNow-beYfHL3_vAbWWB0-79i03kVch8tLVW9p5KKXbGVUXtuHKyJoCaJb70yo1jTpz8kWfagz58gYGSiDLea9LJ4WTSQxTSLPd0q5WG1ucYAy6l-UKQO0qwLUajNK3Wk8QJhvNZySyuHdrHVTb9y3IIiu9LeWaRGMoeWrSR0jRl5lqfVs_2Ldh3En3Fo08MDthnIppIHgvEJantqG3UtN5AhJ5gDeX4YmemI40x3u58j_0PiazKZaaGxjNHvmWAcpTVv_2YtsHEgcgn2ycOrX7Zv7mJKp5Yoc1fFg49fQXg6yLt9_nJgci4fG6WnCqo8GjTO0gS3VeMtihUwnSFrvuAkHYFHWuWI0e8UnEB2yWBFI0CIpt5cJxwsgktYovg9m88e5hpSqufPUw-17Anxvw-4_7NwpZxqyc8ZSQo1uznQVVUc-TZ0ejBgubLD2ceKf3A/4oc/PF_MI_mcQx2QKtnQZbFOnQ/h2/h001.DpGiXKikvLpb73Zxe3m05ZN7n5B67RiqJRgFBqL4jPI)

This resolution was introduced in collaboration with dozens of advocacy organizations, including Popular Democracy whose Executive Director, DaMareo Cooper, said, _“Eroding the 14th Amendment―and its fundamental promises of due process and equal protection under the law―is an assault on the very fabric of our democracy.”_
People are being held in detention facilities in inhumane conditions where they are being denied their right to basic necessities including nutrition and healthcare. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | People in the comments aren’t arguing about parties. # [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240703%2E444211%2EFlZALn)
The last few days on the road across Texas college campuses have been the kind that stick with you. From Wichita Falls to Denton to Arlington and Dallas, the Powered by People organizers, volunteers, and I have been meeting students and helping make sure they’re registered and ready to vote.
Every conversation, every new voter registered, reminds me why this fight matters.
At Midwestern State University, hundreds of students showed up. We listened to each other’s stories, walked through the voting process, and registered students who hadn’t taken that step yet.
[__](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260221.5ZNfTM&refcode=ema20260221-240703&t=3&akid=240703%2E444211%2EFlZALn)
Then at the University of North Texas in Denton, I met Maddie and Jacob. Maddie, a first-generation Hispanic college student, shared the fear her family faces under ICE raids. Jacob, a future teacher, talked about schools in his community that don’t get the resources they need. Both left that day registered to vote.
[__](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260221.5ZNfTM&refcode=ema20260221-240703&t=4&akid=240703%2E444211%2EFlZALn)
In Arlington, I was reminded just how powerful this next generation is. UT Arlington students—leaders in student government, organizers, activists—are already stepping up.
At our town hall at Division Brewing, we talked about the attacks on immigrants, queer and trans Texans, and on young people themselves. Those attacks are meant to divide us. Instead, they’re bringing people together.
I met Dylan and Thomas, just 15 years old, who led a high school walkout and protest. If they can stand up, the least we can do is meet them with the same courage.
[__](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260221.5ZNfTM&refcode=ema20260221-240703&t=5&akid=240703%2E444211%2EFlZALn)
Here’s the truth: the primaries are around the corner. November isn’t far behind, and the energy, passion, and determination of this next generation could decide these midterms. We’re doing the work that works—but imagine us doing it at an even greater scale. That is the margin of victory come November.
With everything Trump, Abbott, and their cronies are going to throw at us, we need to throw everything that we have got into this fight. We must register as many people as possible, turn out every eligible voter, and make sure young people understand the power they hold. This is the fight of the century. Let’s meet this moment together.
Thank you,
Beto O’Rourke

President Trump just claimed that his Republican-controlled Congress has “passed everything they need for the next four years...” = Tell that to working families here in mid-Michigan. Because what I’m hearing is this: prices are still too high. Groceries cost more. Gas is almost three bucks a gallon. And now, more reckless tariffs are threatening to raise costs even further – hitting small businesses and manufacturers right here at home. And the one big policy push from this Congress, the One Big Beautiful Bill, will make things much, much harder for them – gutting Medicaid, food for kids, and utility bill assistance, all to give the biggest handout to the ultra-wealthy in history. body:
Stand with me in demanding an end to Big Tech's so-called "reverse acqui-hire" scheme.
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125856555/603124909/623074613?refcode=jtk1436-fr-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTE3MjI1YzItNDYwZi1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=GaoKvsdtOqIEdDe_d4A-elQ8EEH2TgZXkBonflScZHk=&emci=49c1aa5c-830e-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=117225c2-460f-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=9329426)
---
Friend, a small group of powerful corporations is quietly tightening its grip on the future of artificial intelligence – and on the rules that will govern our economy, our jobs, and our daily lives.
Companies like Google, Meta, and Nvidia already dominate the digital economy. But now, they are using a new and deeply troubling playbook to lock in control of the AI industry before real competition can even begin.
Instead of buying rivals outright, these corporations are quietly licensing technology, poaching top talent, and taking strategic stakes in smaller AI companies. These arrangements look and function like mergers, only they've been designed to avoid public accountability.
**In other words, billionaire CEOs are writing the rules of our technological future behind closed doors.**
If these practices are left unchecked, the consequences will be serious and long lasting: Prices will rise. Innovation will be choked off. Small businesses and startups will be shut out. And a handful of corporations will decide how artificial intelligence shapes our economy, our privacy, and our democracy.
While these companies rush to maximize profits, Americans are left to deal with the fallout: growing risks to personal data, the mass spread of misinformation, and almost no transparency about how AI will affect jobs, communities, and everyday life.
That is why I am demanding action from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and the Department of Justice (DOJ).
I have spent my career investigating corporate misconduct and holding powerful companies accountable. **But standing up to some of the wealthiest corporations around the world requires more than strong letters and public pressure. It requires a grassroots movement strong enough to make sure public voices are heard over corporate money.**
**_[If you believe the future of AI should be shaped by competition, fairness, and the public interest – not monopolies – I hope you'll chip in and stand with me today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125856556/603124922/-1799740860?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1436-fr-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTE3MjI1YzItNDYwZi1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=GaoKvsdtOqIEdDe_d4A-elQ8EEH2TgZXkBonflScZHk=)_**
| | [Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125856557/603124957/-1799740860?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1436-fr-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTE3MjI1YzItNDYwZi1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhNTc1OTNmIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=GaoKvsdtOqIEdDe_d4A-elQ8EEH2TgZXkBonflScZHk=)

I want to tell you about a leader who has me fired up about California's future. **His name is _Randy Villegas_ , and JanePAC is proud to endorse him for California's 22nd Congressional District.** **[The fossil fuel industry has controlled this district for too long, and this year, we finally have a candidate who can take it back — and help us flip the House of Representatives in the process. Will you chip in any amount to his campaign right now to help Randy flip CA-22?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125857354/603127879/1501632997?refcode=ea.3eb7e2d6-470f-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ms=ea.3eb7e2d6-470f-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNlYjdlMmQ2LTQ3MGYtZjExMS1hNjlhLTAwMGQzYTU3NTkzZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yYRkF9iiC0d-cMrASAXwlvP6u4Xm3FJvz1SKzbI2eBs=)** | [DONATE TO RANDY →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125857355/603127880/1501632997?refcode=ea.3eb7e2d6-470f-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ms=ea.3eb7e2d6-470f-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNlYjdlMmQ2LTQ3MGYtZjExMS1hNjlhLTAwMGQzYTU3NTkzZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yYRkF9iiC0d-cMrASAXwlvP6u4Xm3FJvz1SKzbI2eBs=)

CA-22 sits in the heart of the Central Valley — one of the state's largest oil and gas-producing regions and, not coincidentally, one of the most polluted places in America.
The communities here breathe dirty air _every single day_. Their water contains carcinogens. Their farmworkers suffer heat exhaustion in triple-digit temperatures that keep getting worse.**And the Republican currently holding this seat, David Valadao, has done nothing to change that.**
Randy Villegas, on the other hand, has spent his entire career fighting back against these very forces.
As a journalist, he exposed the dangers of pesticides like Roundup and demanded accountability from elected officials. As a school board member, he was the tie-breaking vote to stop his colleagues from banning the phrase "climate change" from classroom materials. He connected elementary schools to clean water. He electrified school buses. He fought for the kids who had no one else in their corner.
Now he's running for Congress to bring that same courage to Washington — to hold corporate polluters accountable, defend public lands, and protect the farmworkers on the front lines of our climate crisis.
And he's doing it against real opposition. **Randy's primary opponent is an oily Democrat with a 40% lifetime score from California Environmental Voters — who was the only Democrat in the California legislature to vote against Prop 50.**
**[That's not the kind of climate leadership the Central Valley deserves, which is why I need you to join me in supporting Randy's campaign today. Big Oil knows exactly what’s at stake, and they could spend whatever it takes to keep a polluter-friendly incumbent in this seat. His name is Randy Villegas , and JanePAC is proud to endorse him for California's 22nd Congressional District. = | = CA-22 sits in the heart of the Central Valley — one of the state's largest oil and gas-producing regions and, not coincidentally, one of the most polluted places in America. The communities here breathe dirty air every single day. Their water contains carcinogens. Their farmworkers suffer heat exhaustion in triple-digit temperatures that keep getting worse.And the Republican currently holding this seat, David Valadao, has done nothing to change that. Randy Villegas, on the other hand, has spent his entire career fighting back against these very forces. As a journalist, he exposed the dangers of pesticides like Roundup and demanded accountability from elected officials. As a school board member, he was the tie-breaking vote to stop his colleagues from banning the phrase "climate change" from classroom materials. He connected elementary schools to clean water. He electrified school buses. He fought for the kids who had no one else in their corner. Now he's running for Congress to bring that same courage to Washington — to hold corporate polluters accountable, defend public lands, and protect the farmworkers on the front lines of our climate crisis. And he's doing it against real opposition.
